content:
"name": "Governance Gate Engine",
      "responsibility": "Decide pass/fail/degrade based on quality impact",
      "inputs": [
        "quality_scores"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "gate_decisions"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "data_flow": [
    "Artifacts \u2192 Lint Sensors \u2192 Row Normalization",
    "Row Normalization \u2192 Context & Intent",
    "Context & Intent \u2192 Quality Scoring",
    "Quality Scoring \u2192 Suppression",
    "Suppression \u2192 Governance Gates"
  ],
  "sandbox_constraints": [
    "No network calls during lint execution",
    "Read-only analysis only",
    "All actions logged to BTS"
  ],
  "deliverables": [
    "MBML module spec",
    "Adapter interfaces",
    "Quality scoring config",
    "Governance gate definitions"
  ]
}
